investigation_notes.Description: The alert indicates a malware incident involving a Trojan:JS/ChatGPTStealer.GVA!MTB embedded in a Chrome Extension JavaScript asset on WKSTN-SALES-080, with user a.jakub@client.ee on Windows 11. SentinelOne Cloud has blacklisted the associated file hash 4a365b80f0de287dcfbf7860075e0956e450048933ddebb0506837afbced404e, identifying it as malicious, and mitigation actions to kill and quarantine were applied. Because the sample is known malicious and was actively blocked on the endpoint, this alert is considered High Priority to ensure complete removal and to verify there is no persistence mechanism or data exfiltration risk.
